name: Tencent Hunyuan (yuanbao.tencent.com)
siteVersion: Next.js shell (hunyuan-yuanbao per repo inventory); exact build pins to be recorded on first live capture
description: Capability package for Tencent's Hunyuan AI assistant web app. The consumer chat product is Tencent Yuanbao at https://yuanbao.tencent.com/ (chat console); https://hunyuan.tencent.com/ is the product/marketing site and console. package sends prompts through the yuanbao composer and reads streamed tool-call answers off the page.
author: ui2api capabilities

capabilities.name: Chat
capabilities.description: Send a prompt on the Yuanbao composer; streamed answer read off the page (deep-search / tool-call content). Exact RPC/selector details to be verified on first live capture.
capabilities.method: ui-path (trusted input + Enter, site's own send handler)

capabilities.name: Conversation history list
capabilities.description: Enumerate past conversations from the sidebar/history UI. Exact endpoint/selector to be verified on first live capture (DOM-sidebar fallback until then).

capabilities.name: Knowledge-base / document Q&A
capabilities.description: Yuanbao supports document Q&A (upload -> COS -> doc analysis; repo inventory notes /api/chat serves tool-call content incl. doc analysis). Upload + ask flow; exact RPC/selector details to be verified on first live capture.

capabilities.name: Voice mode
capabilities.description: Voice input mode exists on the assistant; not exercised in this scaffold. Exact trigger (mic button) to be verified on first live capture.
